name: Inquisitor Dispatcher
body:
Dispatchers destroy their enemies with acid, reducing them to puddles of ruined flesh, efficiently eradicating threats to the faith with nary a trace.

A dispatcher has the following class features.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A dispatcher is not proficient with medium armor or shields of any kind.

This alters the inquisitor’s proficiencies.

Domain

A dispatcher must select the destruction domain, and consequently, if the dispatcher worships a deity, the deity must offer the destruction domain.

This alters domain.

Acid Specialist (Ex)

At 3rd level, a dispatcher casts inquisitor spells with the acid descriptor as though affected by Empower Spell, without using a higher level spell slot.

This replaces solo tactics.

Acidic Affinity (Ex)

Beginning at 3rd level, a dispatcher gains resist acid 5.

This resistance increases by +5 at 6th level, and every three levels thereafter, to a maximum of 30 at 20th level.

Furthermore, a dispatcher adds the list of acid spells below to her list of spells known. These spells do not count against her total number of known spells. Additionally, a dispatcher gains a bonus spell slot for each level of spell she is capable of casting. This spell slot must be used to cast one of these spells.

1st—corrosive touch, 2nd–acid arrow, 3rd–eruptive pustules, 4th–vitriolic mist, 5th–corrosive consumption, 6th–acid fog

This replaces all bonus teamwork feats.
